title: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE NOTICE
content: This data store contains SYNTHETIC MOCK grounding records for pipeline testing only. No threshold here is a clinical standard. Not for patient triage. DimentAI is decision support and does not diagnose.

title: ECHO -> Language domain (design hypothesis)
content: ECHO analyses speech and language. Design hypothesis only: ECHO probes the DSM-5 Language domain via semantic density, word-finding (anomia) and syntactic complexity. Per RACGP Silver Book Box 1, frontotemporal dementia shows early language change. This linkage is a DimentAI engineering hypothesis, not a clinically validated screening signal.

title: STRIDE -> Perceptual-motor (design hypothesis)
content: STRIDE analyses gait and stability. Design hypothesis only: STRIDE probes the DSM-5 Perceptual-motor domain via gait-speed variability, step asymmetry and dual-task cost (DTC). Per Silver Book Box 1, vascular dementia shows general slowing. Linkage is a DimentAI hypothesis, not a validated screening signal.

title: VISTA -> Visuospatial/Executive (design hypothesis)
content: VISTA analyses hand movement and spatial drawing. Design hypothesis only: VISTA probes visuospatial/executive function via Clock Drawing Test style errors and dyspraxia. Per Silver Book Box 1, Lewy body dementia shows early visuospatial deficits. Linkage is a DimentAI hypothesis, not a validated screening signal.

title: FOCUS -> Complex attention (design hypothesis)
content: FOCUS analyses eye tracking and attention. Design hypothesis only: FOCUS probes the DSM-5 Complex-attention domain via fixation stability, scanning efficiency and processing-speed delay. Linkage is a DimentAI hypothesis, not a validated screening signal.

title: ECHO mock risk tiers (FABRICATED)
content: FABRICATED test thresholds aligned to main.py scoring (semantic_density weight 40). Low: semantic_density >= 0.90. Moderate: 0.70-0.89. High-priority flag: < 0.70. These numbers are invented for pipeline testing and carry no clinical meaning.

title: STRIDE mock risk tiers (FABRICATED)
content: FABRICATED test thresholds aligned to main.py scoring (dual_task_cost weight 0.4). Low: DTC <= 20. Moderate: 21-30. High-priority flag: > 30. DTC here is an arbitrary unit for testing; it is NOT the research-variable dual-task cost percentage and has no clinical standing.

title: Composite mock triage cutoff + escalation (FABRICATED)
content: FABRICATED composite rule mirroring main.py: composite = dual_task_cost*0.4 + semantic_density*40. Base triage_level = 'stable' if composite < 50 else 'review_required'. COMPOSITE-ESCALATION: if any individual engine raises a high_priority_flag, the composite is forced to 'review_required' regardless of the weighted score, so a single high-risk domain cannot be averaged away. Invented cutoff for end-to-end testing only.

title: Reversible causes to exclude before dementia attribution
content: Before attributing cognitive variance to progressive dementia, a clinician must exclude reversible causes: acute delirium (due to physical illness), depression (pseudodementia, may also co-exist), medication side effects (psychotropics, anticholinergics, urinary incontinence medicines, antihistamines), and physical/metabolic/structural disease (e.g. electrolyte disturbance, brain tumour, chronic subdural haematoma). A dementia diagnosis cannot be made without confirmed functional interference.
source: RACGP Silver Book 5th edn, Part A. Dementia

title: Mandatory pathology panel to exclude medical cause
content: Pathology panel to exclude a medical cause of cognitive decline: full blood count / routine haematology, biochemistry including electrolytes, calcium, glucose, renal and liver function tests, thyroid function tests (TFTs), and B12 and folate levels. Consider syphilis serology and HIV testing in specific cases. Imaging to exclude tumour or chronic subdural haematoma. Treat abnormalities before any dementia diagnosis.
source: RACGP Silver Book 5th edn, Part A. Dementia

title: Six-step assessment pathway after a flag
content: When a pre-clinical flag is raised, the clinician sequence is: Step 1 cognitive function test (SMMSE/GPCOG/Clock Drawing/RUDAS/KICA as appropriate); Step 2 pathology tests; Step 3 imaging; Step 4 assessment for depression; Step 5 medication review; Step 6 functional assessment. Persistent symptoms after treating reversible causes warrant specialist referral. PBS acetylcholinesterase-inhibitor initiation (Alzheimer's) requires a specialist geriatrician or psychiatrist.
source: RACGP Silver Book 5th edn, Part A. Dementia

title: Endorsed cognitive tools (verify scoring against source)
content: Silver Book endorses SMMSE, GPCOG, Clock Drawing Test, RUDAS (cross-cultural) and KICA/Modified KICA. MMSE is copyrighted and should be replaced by SMMSE. Numeric scoring brackets are NOT in the Silver Book and must be taken from each licensed instrument; do not encode cut-offs from memory.
source: RACGP Silver Book 5th edn, Part A. Dementia

title: TGA non-diagnostic phrasing
content: DimentAI identifies and flags patterns that may warrant further clinical assessment; it does not diagnose dementia or any condition. Outputs are decision support for a qualified clinician and do not replace DSM-5 evaluation, validated cognitive testing, or clinical judgement. Every flag requires clinician-led exclusion of delirium, depression, medication effects and reversible pathology, plus confirmation of functional impact. Wording pending regulatory sign-off (Task 4.1).
